item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v6.0.0-alpha.0 - First v6 Alpha
item.description: We are pleased to announce CoreUI PRO for React v6.0.0-alpha.0, the first alpha of v6. It is built on CoreUI PRO v6.0.0-alpha.0, and each component now imports the stylesheet it renders into, so an app ships only the CSS it uses. The API can still change before the release candidate, so pin the exact version and do not use it in production yet. The v6 documentation is published next to the v5 docs.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v6.0.0-alpha.0 - First v6 Alpha
item.description: We are pleased to announce CoreUI PRO v6.0.0-alpha.0 for Bootstrap, the first alpha of v6. The JavaScript is now written in TypeScript and ships its own type declarations, positioned components move from Popper to Floating UI, one stylesheet serves both text directions, and dist/css gains a stylesheet per component. The API can still change before the release candidate, so pin the exact version and do not use it in production yet. The v6 documentation is published next to the v5 docs.
